text: maria: Quick design check — new first-run helper for the console. Trying an inline quickstart banner with a small icon + 'Try sample' CTA vs a modal. Thoughts on CTA wording and the icon contrast? Screenshot attached. kevin: Inline seems more discoverable. CTA wording: 'Try sample' feels fine but a bit vague. 'Open sample' or 'Launch demo' are alternatives. ashley: 'Launch demo' might sound too heavy (implies running infra). Lean 'Open sample' or 'View sample'. Accessibility: add aria-label to the icon, e.g. aria-label="Quickstart sample projects". oliver: Good catch. Also the icon contrast on the blue strip is ~2.6:1 — fails AA for small scale icons. Can we push to >=3:1 or switch to a monochrome outline? maria: What about swapping the icon to a simple package/box SVG (solid) — should raise contrast and be more neutral than sparkles. kevin: Emojis are tempting but cause screen-reader weirdness. If we keep decorative emoji, add role="img" and aria-label; better: use SVG with and focusable="false". ashley: CTA semantics: if the inline helper is persistent in the rail, make the quickstart CTA secondary ('View sample') and keep primary actions (Create project) elsewhere on the page. oliver: Keyboard nav: ensure the inline helper is reachable via skip link (skip to quickstart) and avoid focus traps unless we use a modal. If modal, trap focus properly and provide escape. maria: ux-bot data: funnel drops at the 'open quickstart' touchpoint. Small copy tweak could reduce hesitation. Recommend an A/B test: 'Try sample' vs 'Open sample project'. kevin: A/B plan: 10k impressions or 4 weeks. Primary metric: % who create project within 24h after clicking quickstart. ashley: Also: announce status changes for screen readers. Example: <div role="status" aria-live="polite">Sample ready</div> when provisioning completes. oliver: I'll prototype variant B (inline solid icon, 'Open sample', contrast tweaks, aria attributes, skip-link) and put files in /design/quickstart/variant-B. ETA EOD tomorrow. maria: Thanks team — pinned checklist: contrast >= 3:1, icon has aria-label/title, CTA copy short & unambiguous, keyboard skip-link, no emoji-only icons. :thumbsup:
